Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this game. It has been a challenging day but in the end, cricket fans all over the world will be happy. The action in the 2022 Women's World Cup continues on Tuesday, the 8th of March. Australia Women will take on Pakistan Women which will begin at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT). The build up though will begin much earlier as usual. Do join us then. Cheers!

Sophie Devine, the skipper of New Zealand Women, says they needed a quick turnaround and she is extremely grateful to the ground staff and to Bangladesh as well. Adds, Amelia Kerr and Frances Mackay did well in the bowling department and she is happy to have bowling varieties. Tells, it was a good batting wicket and she was disappointed not to score there but credits the way Bates and Kerr played. Mentions, they have India next and it will be a cracker of a game as well.

Nigar Sultana, captain of Bangladesh Women says that the openers did really well and Fargana Hoque got her first fifty which was exciting to watch. She adds that around 160 would have been a good total but they did not have good partnerships in the middle. Adds that they never played in conditions like today and both their batters and bowlers found it a bit difficult out there but they learned a lot as well. She ends by saying that they did improve on the performance from the last match and will look to keep on improving further.

Suzie Bates is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. She says it is a strange day with rain and all at homeground but credit to Bangladesh, groundstaff and the umpires who did really well. Adds, they needed to win after their previous loss. On asked about the milestone, 1000 runs in World Cups, she was not aware but she is happy to help the team win as there are big games coming. Mentions, she is happy to have friends and families around to cheer them.
Presentation time...

Bangladesh Women deserve a lot of credit today as it is never easy to come up against a big gun and take the game to them. They did just that at the start with the ball and Salma Khatun even knocked over the dangerous Sophie Devine fairly early on. After that though, the continuous drizzle didn't help their bowlers and it got more and more difficult to bowl with the wet ball. The lack of wickets meant the opposition was able to dictate proceedings and Bangladesh soon faded away from the contest. They will take a lot of heart though with the intensity they showed, with the bat early on and then in the field as well.

The White Ferns didn't get off to the bests of starts with the bat as run-scoring was a bit difficult. Just when the runs started flowing, the skipper Sophie Devine perished. It was then a sublime stand with the experienced Suzie Bates and a player in red-hot form, Amelia Kerr that completely shifted the momentum in the hosts' favour. The pair put on a stand of 108 runs and when things got a bit difficult as the rain got heavier, both of them were able to change gears and find the fence at regular intervals. Bates was the star of the show at her home ground as she brought up 1000 runs in World Cups and saw her side home in what might prove to be a big victory for New Zealand Women in the context of their tournament.

A match that looked impossible to get underway just a few hours ago has now been completed and it has been an intriguing contest. We had overnight rain, there was rain in the morning as well and with no floodlights on the ground, play could only go on till natural light permitted. But with a little help from the weather and a lot of hard work being put in by the ground staff, the match got completed and the hosts were all smiles in the end as they get their first points on the board.

It's been a long wait but finally, New Zealand Women do get their World Cup campaign underway with a win courtesy of Suzie Bates and Amelia Kerr. What a match-winning stand this has been between the pair!
FOUR! Winning runs and New Zealand open their account! Very full and around off. Kerr drives it through point for a boundary. New Zealand Women win by 9 wickets.

Short ball, outside off. Bates waits and looks to cut but gets an outside edge to third man. Jahanara Alam chases and does brilliantly to flick it back just at the edge of the ropes. Three runs taken. Superb fielding from Bangladesh today. Just a single needed now.
Tossed up, on off. Kerr shuffles across and scoops it past short fine leg for three runs as the ball stops near the fence. 100 run stand between these two comes up as well.
On a length, on off, Bates chops it late to short third man for a single.
Tossed up, angling arounnd leg. Bates misses her sweep and gets hit on the pads.
FOUR! 1000 World Cup runs for Suzie Bates! What a player for New Zealand! Tossed up, outside off. Bates drives it through covers for a boundary.
Fuller ball, on the pads, Kerr sweeps it to deep backward square leg where another superb stop sees a couple of runs save.
Fuller ball, around off, worked to wide long on for a single.
FOUR! In a hurry now! Fabulous batting from Bates! Short again, outside off. Bates dabs it late past short third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Innovative! Tossed up, on off. Bates reverse paddles it to the vacant third man region for a boundary,
Targets the pads. Kerr sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Short ball, on middle. Bates pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full and on middle. Bates wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 25 needed in 54 balls.
Full ball, outside off. Kerr drags it to long on for a single.
Short ball, outside off. Bates waits and slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Now hits it to long on for a single.
A single as this is hit to deep covers.

CHANCE!  A fuller ball, outside off. Suzie Bates comes down the track, swings across the line but misses her shot. The keeper fails to collect the ball and Bates is back with a big slide. Might have given a thin chance to Bangladesh.
FOUR! Boundaries coming in almost each over now! On a length, outside off. Kerr cuts it past point and it races away to the fence.
Length and outside  off, cut away to deep point for a single.
A fuller ball, outside off. Kerr gets on her knees and hammers it to long on only for one.
Length ball, outside off. Bates slaps it to deep cover for a single.
On a length, outside off. Kerr bunts it to long on for one.
Short ball, outside off, this is hit to deep cover for one.
Lata Mondal is introduced into the attack now.
Fuller and outside off, driven to deep cover for one.
A length ball, outside off. Bates pulls it to deep mid-wicket where the fielder does really well to put in a dive and stop it. Two runs taken. 100 up as well.
Wide! Way outside off. Wide given.

FOUR! Fifty for Suzie Bates! What an impressive innings this is from her. 28th ODI fifty! A length ball, outside off. Bates carves it through point and beats the diving deep fielder as well to find the fence.
Full ball, angling across. Kerr slogs-sweeps it but straight to deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Length ball, outside off. Bates smashes it to deep cover for one more.
Short of a length, on off. Kerr pulls it off the higher part of the bat, to square leg for a single.

Excellent delivery to end an exciting over. Bates steps out and Jahanara Alam fires in another yorker at the leg stump. Bates gets beaten for pace and the ball misses the leg stump by just a few inches. 50 needed now off 72 balls.
Clever! Suzie Bates moves across and Jahanara Alam just stops in her delivery.
FOUR! Suzie Bates almost comes halfway down the track and muscles the length ball into the mid-wicket fence. The fielder from the square leg fence puts in the dive but it goes in vain.
Really well bowled! Another yorker, on middle. Kerr digs it out towards mid on for a run.

NO BALL! This could be really costly! A high full toss, outside off. Bates pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for a single. The umpire signals a no ball for height and Kerr will have a free hit off the next delivery.
Alam nails the yorker again, this time at the base of the off stump. Kerr jams it out towards backward point where another misfield allows the batters to get a run.
Full and wide again, Bates hangs deep and thumps it down to mid off where the fielder fumbles the ball. They do get the single.
Alam gets the wide yorker in this time. Bates has a swipe across the line but misses the ball completely.
WIDE! Full and wide, a bit too wide though.
The rain is getting heavier now...

In the air...safe! Nicely tossed up, around off. Amelia Kerr steps out but doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball. Kerr ends up chipping it right back over the bowler's head and Lata Mondal does well to run in from long on and put in the dive to save a couple of runs. 60 needed now off 78 balls.
On off, this is swatted down towards long on for a single by Bates.
FOUR! New Zealand Women look to be in a hurry now. Tossed up, on off. Suzie Bates dances down the track and drills it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Bates makes room and Ahmed just pushes it fuller and at the stumps. Bates nudges it down to backward point.
A bit flighted, around off, Kerr steps out and heaves it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sliding in from well outside off. Kerr defends it out.
Funny view! Bangladesh wanted to take drinks but the umpires were against having it. Might be due to the conditions getting dark.
Pitched up, on off and this is classically driven down the ground for another single.

It's getting real gloomy out there. The light drizzle is continuous but more dark clouds seemed to have appeared now. Remember, a minimum of 20 overs need to be completed in the second innings for the game to be considered as an ODI match. Hope it doesn't start to rain heavily now.
Full and straight, drilled down to long on for a run by Bates.
Outside off and slashes away straight to the fielder at cover-point.
No two there! Bit of width on offer, Kerr leans back and cuts it hard towards deep point for a single.
A length ball, around off. This is tapped towards covers for a quick single.
Short and wide, Bates fails to put it away as she finds the fielder at cover.
On middle, turned through mid-wicket for yet another single. Six singles off the over! 72 needed now off 90 balls.

Deft touch but the outfield is just too slow. Quicker and flatter, on off. Kerr opens the face of the bat at the last moment to play it past short third man. The ball stops and it will only be a single.
Pushed well outside off, Bates reaches out and strokes it to deep cover for a single.
Floated this time, around off. Kerr uses her feet to push it down the ground for a run.
Full and straight, knocked down to long on for one more.
Shorter in length, on off. Amelia Kerr heaves it down towards long on for a single.
Spilled down the leg side, this is paddled away to fine leg for a single.
Brilliant fielding! Quicker, on off and this is slapped away to the left of point. Lata Mondal springs to her left and makes a really good stop.
FOUR! Amelia Kerr is finding the gaps at regular intervals now. On middle, Kerr plays the slog sweep and dissects the fielders at deep mid-wicket and long on perfectly to pick up a boundary.
Dragged down again, on leg stump. Suzie Bates rocks back and pulls it hard towards the square leg fence for just a single.
A touch shorter, around leg. Bates makes room to pull but mistimes it towards square leg.
Tossed up, from 'round the wicket and around leg. Bates blocks it out.
A single as this is again hit to deep cover. 84 needed in 102 balls.
Short ball, outside off. Kerr knocks it to deep cover for one more.
Tossed up, outside off, hit to deep cover for a single.
Slightly short, around off. Kerr goes back in her crease and cuts it through point for one.
FOUR! Good shot! Tossed up, on off. Kerr slogs it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter, straying around off. Bates slaps it to deep point for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap! A full toss, on middle. Kerr pushes it in between mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary.
Full ball, outside off. A squae drive by Kerr but straight to point.
Full again, eased down to long on for one.
Very full and outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
Outside off, worked to deep cover for one.
Short ball, outside off. Bates looks to cut but gets an outside edge and it flies past the gloves of the keeper to third man for a brace.
Ritu Moni comes into the attack now.
On middle, pushed on the leg side.
Short ball this time, outside off. Kerr on the back foot, looks to cut but misses.
An arm ball, sliding outside off. Kerr punches it to covers.
Full and on off. Blocked out.
Tossed up, coming with the angle. Kerr looks to defend but gets an inside edge to square leg.
Flatter ball, outside off, cut to point.
Down the leg side. Bates helps it to the fine leg region for a couple of runs.
Fuller ball, outside off. Good shot to open the innings as Kerr drives it to deep cover. A single taken.
Amelia Kerr comes in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Finally, Salma Khatun gets the wicket! A huge, huge wicket of Sophie Devine. Khatun goes over the wicket this time, shorter ball and it skids through. Devine frees her front leg and looks to pull but the ball sneaks through and rattles the stumps. 105 needed in 122 balls.
Fuller and on off. Bates again hits at mid-wicket but this time a fielder is stationed.
FOUR! Freebie! Shorter and on middle. Bates pulls it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up from around the wicket. Bates watchfully defends it out.
Shorter, coming with the angle and Bates slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Short and outside off. Bates cuts it to covers.
Tossed up, fuller and outside off. Bates looks to drive but plays with inner half of the blade, back to the bowler.
This is very wide. Bates cuts it straight to point.
Tossed up, outside off. Devine pushes it wide of covers for a single.
Fuller and outside off. Kept out.
End of Powerplay! Bangladesh Women can field a maximum of 5 fielders outside the 25-yard circle now.

Quicker and flatter, close to the off pole. Devine makes room to cut but gets a thick outside edge, which seems to be running down into the third man fence. The ball slows up and the fielder cuts it off, not before the batters run three though.
Nicely flighted, on off. Bates heaves it towards mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat and they take a single.
A tad bit short, around off. Bates pushes it down to mid off.
Flatter and around off. Bates rocks back and punches it through covers for a couple of runs.
Lucky! Down the leg side and Bates flicks it straight to the fielder at square leg. That should have been put away!
This is dragged down on off. Devine rocks back but mistimes the pull towards mid on for just a single.
On middle and shaping in. Devine flicks it through square leg and picks up a run.
Drop and run! On off, pushed out onto the off side for another quick single.

Brilliant fielding! A length ball, around off. Suzie Bates tries to be aggressive and walks down the track. As she looks to go over mid off, she gets an outside edge and slices it over short third man. The fielder gives chase and slides in to cut it off. Two taken.
Around the top of off and shaping back in just a bit. Bates hangs back and keeps it out on the off side.
Good running! On off, nudged towards covers for a quick single.
Full and straight, shaping in. Devine blocks it out.

Bates is standing well outside the crease and Alam pulls back the length. Bates taps it towards cover-point and sets off for a quick single. The shy comes in at the bowler's end but it is a bit wide and the fielder backing up makes a half-stop. They do get an overthrow in the end.
Around the top of off. Defended out.
FOUR! Too much width on offer this time and Suzie Bates isn't going to miss out. Short of a length, outside off. Bates hangs back and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Length again, pushed a bit wider. Bates nudges it down towards backward point.
A touch fuller, around off and shaping away. Bates drives on the up and with the swing, through the cover region. They pick up a couple of runs.
A length ball, outside off. Bates taps it towards cover.
Lovely bowling! On a nagging length, close to the off pole and this one curls back in off the surface. Devine cuts close to the body and straight towards cover.
A bit slower, on off and cutting back into the right-hander. Bates makes a bit of room but mistimes it towards the cover region for a quick single.
Length this time, around leg. Bates plays it with soft hands towards silly mid on.
Full and straight. Blocked out.
Fullish delivery, on off. Suzie Bates defends it out off the front foot.
Bye! Nicely bowled! A length ball, pitched up around off and the ball swings back in nicely. Devine looks to cut but misses and the keeper spills it. The batters sneak in a bye.
Who will start from the other end? It is Fariha Trisna.
Drifted into middle and leg, this is tucked away 'round the corner for a single. 7 off the first over.
FOUR! Powered! Shorter in length, on off and this one sits up nicely for the batter. Sophie Devine stands tall and pulls it away into the square leg fence.
Fullish delivery, angling into middle and leg, shaping away nicely. Devine defends it out.
A bit too straight from Alam and Devine is off the mark with a flick through square leg. She comes back for the second with ease.
Good-length ball, around off. Devine hits it on the up towards mid off.
Alam starts off with a short ball, around off and this one shapes away from the batter. Sophie Devine looks to thrash it away but mistimes it towards cover.
